points.what: EMEA orders fell 15.4% WoW, contributing -21 orders, the largest negative driver at 210% of the week's net order change.
points.so_what: EMEA's decline was the single biggest driver behind the week's order shortfall against target.

points.what: Search orders fell 4.0% WoW, contributing -20 orders, 200% of the week's net order change.
points.so_what: As the largest traffic source, Search's slowdown outweighed gains from other channels and drove most of the order decline.

points.what: APAC orders rose 4.7% WoW, contributing +14 orders.
points.so_what: APAC's growth partly offset the declines in EMEA and Search, but was not enough to prevent total orders from falling WoW.

points.what: AOV fell 4.0% WoW to $84.86, though it remained up 5.4% YoY.
points.so_what: Revenue fell more than orders this week, pointing to smaller basket sizes rather than fewer orders alone driving the shortfall.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell to 11.4%, a notable improvement of 2.1 pp WoW and down 6.3 pp YoY.
points.so_what: Order quality improved this week even though overall order volume still missed target.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of Dec 29 was 11.2%, down 0.2 pp WoW but up 1.0 pp YoY.
points.so_what: The year-on-year increase in returns is the trend to watch even as the short-term move improved.

summary.headline: Behind target on orders (75.3%) and revenue (74.9%) this week, both down WoW, while YTD revenue also trails target at 83.7% attainment.

points.what: Orders were 678, 75.3% of target, and down 1.5% WoW.
points.so_what: The week fell short of what's needed to keep pace with the quarterly target.

points.what: Revenue was $51,003, 74.9% of target, and down 3.0% WoW.
points.so_what: Revenue's steeper WoW decline than orders points to smaller basket sizes adding to the shortfall against target.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 83.7% of target, behind for the year.
points.so_what: The year's shortfall is being carried forward and the current weekly pace is not closing it.

points.what: New signups fell 15.0% WoW and 3.7% YoY, while orders grew 48.4% YoY.
points.so_what: Signups are the weak spot in an otherwise YoY-growing week, not keeping pace with order growth.

points.what: Weekly orders were 75.3% of target and weekly revenue was 74.9% of target, both behind for the week.
points.so_what: Both weekly measures missed target, adding to the shortfall already carried into the quarter.

points.what: QTD revenue trails target by $29,480, with 10 weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: Closing that gap requires revenue above the recent weekly pace for the rest of the quarter.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 83.7% of target, and the required weekly run-rate of $74,758 is well above the current 8-week run-rate of $50,363.
points.so_what: At the current run-rate, the full-year target is out of reach without a substantial step-up in weekly revenue.

points.what: New signups fell 15.0% WoW, a notable drop, and were down 3.7% YoY to 233.
points.so_what: A notable weekly decline alongside a year-on-year fall signals weakening new customer acquisition.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of Dec 29 rose 1.0 pp YoY to 11.2%, though it fell 0.2 pp WoW.
points.so_what: The year-on-year rise in returns is the less favorable trend to watch even as the week-on-week move improved.

points.what: The current 8-week revenue run-rate of $50,363 is well below the $74,758 weekly rate required to hit the full-year target.
points.so_what: Unless weekly revenue rises well above the recent pace, the full-year target will not be reached.
